method: Integer Linear Programming with PuLP + CBC solver. Formulate as: Minimize 4X + 3Y subject to X + Y <= 1000, X >= 2Y + 300 (i.e., X - 2Y >= 300), X,Y >= 0 integer. Solve with pulp.PULP_CBC_CMD(msg=0) for exact optimal integer solution.
steps: Define decision variables X, Y as integer LpVariables with non-negative lower bounds
Add constraint: X - 2*Y >= 300 (X at least twice Y plus 300)
Extract optimal solution and total cost
